column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a lyre of ten” is rendered “an instrument of ten strings.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֶסֶד (“the steadfast love”) is rendered “the goodness.”
Close to the Hebrew; יַחַד (“together, alike”) is rendered “individually.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִתְשׁוּעָה (“for victory”) is rendered “for safety.”
